title: Jawaher: A Multidialectal Dataset of Arabic Proverbs for LLM Benchmarking

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM zero-shot performance on translating and explaining culturally rich Arabic proverbs, assessing the generated outputs for cultural relevance, sensitivity, and depth of explanation via human and automatic metrics to highlight Western and Anglo-centric biases.
Benchmarking models across 20 different Arabic regional dialects to measure their capability to comprehend, translate, and idiomatically contextualize non-English figurative language.
